patterns: Official unauthenticated public endpoint keyed by board slug
isListed visibility enforced by the CLI

novel_features.name: Visibility-safe structured job discovery
novel_features.description: Lists only publicly listed Ashby jobs and supports structured filtering across department, team, location, workplace type, employment type, publication date, currency, and compensation range.
novel_features.rationale: The raw public response can contain records whose isListed field is false, so the CLI enforces visibility and provides native structured filters.
novel_features.example: ashby-pp-cli postings list ashby --remote --department Engineering --agent --select id,title,location,department
novel_features.why_it_matters: Agents and job seekers get keyless machine-readable discovery without surfacing an unlisted posting returned upstream.

narrative.headline: Search, filter, sync, and inspect public Ashby job postings without an API key.
narrative.value_prop: Turn any known Ashby job-board name into structured, agent-friendly job data while enforcing Ashby's public-listing boundary.
narrative.auth_narrative: No Ashby API key or customer account is required. Authenticated recruiting, candidate, and application-management APIs are intentionally out of scope.

quickstart.comment: List publicly visible jobs from Ashby's board

quickstart.command: ashby-pp-cli postings list ashby --remote --department Engineering --agent --select id,title,location,department
ashby-pp-cli sync ashby && ashby-pp-cli search engineer --board ashby
quickstart.comment: Create a local mirror and search it offline

troubleshoots.symptom: The board returns not found or no jobs
troubleshoots.fix: Use the board slug from jobs.ashbyhq.com/<slug>, not the display name or full URL.
Add --include-compensation and confirm the board publishes structured compensation.

narrative.when_to_use: Use for public career-site discovery, recruiting-market research, job alerts, structured exports, and local analysis of known Ashby boards.
anti_triggers: Do not access authenticated recruiting data.
Do not enumerate unknown boards or reveal unlisted postings.
